_README.purpose: Hand-curated #1 match overrides for the Majestic comparison tool. This file is owned by a person, not by a build script.
_README.why_separate: The catalog files (v2test.json, hivis-comparison-data.json) are regenerated from source spreadsheets. Anything stored inside them is destroyed on the next rebuild. These decisions cannot be regenerated, so they live here instead.
_README.precedence: The tool reads this file first and falls back to any override still inline in a catalog record. That means a catalog can be swapped or rebuilt without a flag day.

fields.bestMatch: Majestic part number to pin as the #1 (Best) match.
fields.summary: One-line summary shown on the #1 card.
fields.description: The 'why Majestic' paragraph for the #1 match.

_README.editing: The tool's Curator mode writes pins to browser storage; its 'Export overrides' button emits this whole file, ready to commit. Re-pinning a part drops its old written copy, because that copy names the part it was written about.
